summary: Backend: 11/12 endpoints PASS via pytest (health, templates, /auth/me unauth-401 & auth-200, projects CRUD, messages, versions, restore, export ZIP, mocked GitHub/Vercel, delete). The only failing test is POST /api/ai/generate which returns 500 from server (ingress shows 502 after ~60s ingress timeout) because the Emergent LLM key budget is exhausted. Backend logs: 'litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.667572, Max budget: 0.4'. Because AI generation is broken, refine snapshot creation and follow-on flows that depend on a real LLM response cannot be verified end-to-end, but messages/versions/restore endpoints themselves return 200 and behave correctly when generation succeeds (verified by code review + 200 responses for the dependent endpoints). Frontend: Landing renders with hero, features, workflow, templates sections. Clicking 'Sign in' navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=...%2Fdashboard (verified). /dashboard without session redirects to /. With seeded session_token cookie, /dashboard renders 'Welcome back, Galio Tester', Templates dialog opens and lists all 6 templates. /studio/{id} renders the 3-panel layout, Plan/Build/Debug/Refine mode tabs, Desktop/Tablet/Mobile device toggles, index.html/styles.css/script.js code tabs, History, Export ZIP, and Publish dropdown with GitHub/Vercel items both showing MOCKED.

critical.issue: Emergent LLM key budget exhausted ('Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.667572, Max budget: 0.4'). Endpoint returns 500 (502 via ingress after ~60s). This blocks the WOW build/refine/debug flow. Not a code bug — quota/key problem.

integration_issues.issue: Backend AI endpoint fails due to LLM budget exhaustion; the Studio UI will surface an error toast and never populate preview/code. Front-end is wired correctly — the failure is upstream.

action_items: URGENT: Refresh / top-up the Emergent LLM key budget (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=sk-emergent-462C32516063091F92). Current spend 0.667572 exceeds 0.4 cap so every /api/ai/generate call fails 500. No code change needed.
Once budget is restored, re-run the AI build+refine test (TestAI::test_build_then_refine) to validate version snapshot and messages flow end-to-end.
Consider catching the BadRequestError from litellm and returning a clearer 402/503 with 'LLM quota exceeded' instead of generic 500, so the frontend can show a friendlier toast.
Consider streaming or async job pattern for /api/ai/generate — Claude Sonnet build calls can take 60–120s and currently risk Kubernetes ingress 502 (60s timeout) even when generation succeeds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and mixes auth, projects, AI, export, integrations. Still acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routers (auth/projects/ai/integrations) as it grows.
AI endpoint timeout risk: ingress proxy times out at ~60s, but Claude generation can take longer. Recommend either reducing max_tokens, switching to streaming, or returning a job_id and polling.
Exception handling in /api/ai/generate wraps every LLM error in a single 500 detail — useful errors like quota-exceeded are flattened. Add per-error mapping (402 for quota, 504 for timeout).

_safe_json_extract silently falls back to empty html/css/js on parse failure; combined with `or project.get('html')` this could leave the project unchanged with a misleading 200 response. Consider returning a 'partial' flag.
Cookie is set with samesite='none', secure=True — correct for preview domain. Good.
All Mongo queries correctly exclude _id via {'_id': 0}. Good.
No rate limiting on /api/ai/generate — a single malicious user could burn the whole LLM budget (as we are seeing now). Add per-user/per-IP rate limits.

data-testid attributes are missing on key Studio buttons (mode tabs, device toggles, Send, Publish menu items, Export ZIP). Tests had to fall back to text selectors. Recommend adding data-testid for future regression.

success_rate.backend: 92% (11/12 pytest cases pass; the failing one is AI-generate blocked by external LLM quota)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of UI flows tested rendered correctly (landing, auth redirect URL, protected route redirect, dashboard, templates dialog, studio 3-panel + mode tabs + device toggles + code panel + publish MOCKED dropdown)

rca of the issue: RCA: /api/ai/generate returns HTTP 500 (and HTTP 502 at ingress on long requests). Root cause confirmed from backend.err.log: emergentintegrations -> litellm raises 'OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.667572, Max budget: 0.4' before any Claude completion is produced. Mitigation: (a) refresh/raise the Emergent LLM key budget; (b) wrap the LlmChat call to map BudgetExceeded -> HTTP 402 with clear message; (c) add basic per-user rate limiting on /api/ai/generate to prevent future budget burns; (d) consider async job pattern to avoid 60s ingress timeout.
